bead.title: Document subprocess harness evidence signals
bead.description: Inventory the routing evidence available from subprocess harnesses such as codex and claude. Document which signals are eligibility-critical versus ranking-only, what freshness rules apply, and which live-utilization probes are intentionally absent in this step.
bead.acceptance: 1. The matrix or companion note classifies subprocess harness evidence sources by eligibility-critical versus ranking-only use. 2. Freshness rules and unknown-signal fallback are documented. 3. Any missing live-utilization probe is listed as an explicit follow-up bead or documented as unavailable.
